situations.headline: Xingye requisitions EGM to remove entire FEG board ahead of 3 Nov 2026 vote

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Xingye requisitions EGM to remove entire FEG board ahead of 3 Nov 2026 vote (interest 7, risk 7)

thesis.text: FEG is now a binary governance/control event: a 34.57% strategic holder (Xingye Silver & Tin, a well-capitalised Chinese miner) is seeking to oust the entire incumbent board via s249F EGM on 3 Nov 2026, conditioning ~US$190m of committed development capital on the board change. Key permanent-loss risks (loss of Wonogiri licence, at-risk Woyla contract, deteriorating balance sheet) are asserted by the requisitioning shareholder and unconfirmed by the company; outcome of the vote and FEG's forthcoming response will determine whether the projects receive funding or continue to stall under litigation/regulatory risk.
